people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.
translations.bsb: and be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
translations.asv: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest in thy land.
